description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling WebSocket messages, including sending, receiving, and managing message threads, as well as exception handling related to WebSocket streams.

classes.name: MessageReceiver
classes.description: A thread class that receives WebSocket messages from the client, supporting blocking, non-blocking, and callback-based reception.

classes.name: MessageSender
classes.description: A thread class that sends WebSocket messages to the client, supporting synchronous and asynchronous sending.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket message or part of a message.
